_readme: Hand resolutions for rrFetch call sites whose area argument is a variable.
A dynamic area cannot be classified by reading the call, so each one was
read once, by a person, and recorded here with the reason. v8-callsites.py
fails if a dynamic site has no entry (A2a) AND if an entry no longer matches
a live call site (A2b) -- a stale exemption is how a gate goes quiet without
Key is "<file>::<identifier>", not file:line. A line number shifts on every
edit above it and the entry silently stops matching; an identifier survives
edits and fails loudly if renamed.
`area` is the path WITHOUT any query string -- the query is per-call and
does not change routing or authorization.
Resolved 2026-09-07, each by reading the assignment immediately above its
